Task “{title}”, {names}: {why}. This branch is paused.

Task “{title}”, {names}: {why}. This branch is paused for your call.

While task “{title}”{where} was running {call}, the daemon (or {whose}'s process) restarted, so it's unclear whether it finished. The task is waiting for you; the runtime won't redo it on its own.
After checking, choose "{executed}" or "{notExecuted}" and the maintainer carries on accordingly; you can also reply to it in the task details.
